claim_notes: Materials 18(19), 4478; published 2025-09-25; PMID 41095305; PMCID PMC12525880. Ana Paula Piedade is the editor, not an author.

deduplication.basis: Composition-scope review of all current polymer/composite identities and semantic PA12/nylon-12/polyamide-12 aliases across the complete legacy graph and frozen computed records; no PA12 identity found. Existing polymer families PLA, ABS, PETG, ASA, PC/ABS, PDMS, NR, NBR, PUR, PBS, lignin, PHBV and PBAT are not PA12. Prior PA12-CF15 observations are filled-formulation observations, not admitted pure-PA12 identities. Product-label absence alone is not the distinction argument.
